fields.statement: QA at 78269c0d, hands-on with the built test binaries: in a scratch TMPDIR made, for each of rhiza-api-budget-, rhiza-index-budget-, rhiza-slice-budget- and rhiza-quiet-, a prefixed folder with content back-dated 2h (touch -d) and a fresh prefixed one, plus an old other-old folder. Built go test -c binaries for internal/api, internal/index and internal/slice and ran each with TMPDIR set and -test.run '^$' (TestMain only): all exit 0, and afterwards the three old budget folders were gone while their fresh ones and other-old stayed. Built internal/quiettest's binary and ran TestTakeTurnOneAtATime (calls takeTurn) with the same TMPDIR: PASS, rhiza-quiet-old gone, rhiza-quiet-fresh and other-old kept, and the run's own rhiza-quiet-<ppid> removed on exit. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/tmpsweep/ ./internal/quiettest/ ok.
